what: Download and Format Spatially Explicit Load Enrichment Calculation Tool (SELECT) Data
title: Download and Format Spatially Explicit Load Enrichment Calculation Tool (SELECT) Data
text: SELECTRdata provides convenience functions downloading raster tabular data used Spatially Explicit Load Enrichment Calculation Tool (SELECT). providing SpatRaster object target watershed, functions available download cropped: - National Land Cover Dataset - FEMA USA Structures - Census Blocks - TIGER County Boundaries - USDA Agricultural Census - EPA NPDES Permits - U.S. Census Bureau Urbanized Areas Sources add: - Point sources (via ECHO echor) - MS4 urbanized areas (via US Census)

title: Download and Format Spatially Explicit Load Enrichment Calculation Tool (SELECT) Data
text: can install development version SELECTRdata like :
code: install.packages("SELECTRdata", repos = c("https://txwri.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org"))

title: Download and Format Spatially Explicit Load Enrichment Calculation Tool (SELECT) Data
code: library(SELECTRdata) library(terra) #> Warning: package 'terra' was built under R version 4.3.3 #> terra 1.8.10  ## we need a template file, this is the thomsoncreek watershed in Texas dem <- system.file("extdata", "thompsoncreek.tif", package = "SELECTRdata") dem <- terra::rast(dem)  gpkg <- system.file("extdata", "thompsoncreek.gpkg", package = "SELECTRdata") wbd <- terra::vect(gpkg, layer = "wbd")  dem <- terra::mask(dem, wbd,                    filename = tempfile(fileext = ".tif")) ## set the following GDAL options to connect to ## MRLC's AWS S3 bucket set_gdal_config("AWS_NO_SIGN_REQUEST", "YES")  ## download the NLCD file cropped to the extents of the watershed nlcd <- SELECTRdata::download_nlcd(template = dem,                                     overwrite = TRUE,                                    progress = 1) #> |---------|---------|---------|---------|=========================================                                           plot(nlcd) plot(wbd, add = TRUE)

title: Download and Format Spatially Explicit Load Enrichment Calculation Tool (SELECT) Data
code: buildings <- download_buildings(template = dem) #> Registered S3 method overwritten by 'jsonify': #>   method     from     #>   print.json jsonlite #> Iterating ■■■■■■■■■ 25% | ETA: 3sIterating ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■ 50% | ETA: #> 2sIterating ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■ 75% | ETA: 1s plot(buildings) plot(wbd, add = TRUE)

title: Download NPDES permits — download_NPDES_permits
text: Downloads NPDES permits EPA ECHO API services within bounds SpatRast template.

title: Download NPDES permits — download_NPDES_permits
code: download_NPDES_permits(   template,   permit_component = "POT",   permit_status = "EFF",   output = tempfile(fileext = ".gpkg") )

title: Download NPDES permits — download_NPDES_permits
text: template SpatRaster object. permit_component character vector one following: PRE (pretreatment), CAF (CAFO), CSO (CSO), POT (Publicly Owned Treatment Works, default), BIO (Biosolids), SWS (Stormwater Small MS4), SWM (Stormwater Medium/Large MS4), SWI (Stormwater Industrial), SWC (Stormwater Construction). permit_status character vector one following: EFF (effective, default), EXP (expired), PND (pending), TRM (terminated), RET (retired), NON (needed), ADC (administratively continued). output character file path specifying raster file stored. Defaults temporary file.

title: Download NPDES permits — download_NPDES_permits
text: SpatVector object

Defaults temporary file. overwrite logical. TRUE, filename overwritten verbose Logical, TRUE informative messages printed. ... additional arguments writing files, see terra::writeRaster()
